description: Source code implementing translation utilities for gettext, including functions to load and manage translation messages from MO, PO, and JSON formats, and providing methods for message retrieval with context and pluralization support.

classes.name: translator
classes.description: Struct representing a translation manager with message mappings and pluralization formula.

methods.name: newMoTranslator
methods.description: Creates a new translator instance from MO file data or filename.

methods.name: newPoTranslator
methods.description: Creates a new translator instance from PO file data or filename.

methods.name: newJsonTranslator
methods.description: Creates a new translator instance from JSON data, language, and filename.

methods.name: PGettext
methods.description: Retrieves a translated message string given context and message ID.

methods.name: PNGettext
methods.description: Retrieves a pluralized translated message based on context, message ID, plural ID, and number.
